title: UI Motion Spec Compiler
description: Verifies motion spec: durations in valid range, reduced-motion override for every animation, valid easing curves, enter/exit transitions defined

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract animation types, duration scale, easing functions, reduced-motion policy

pipeline.title: Verify Motion Spec
pipeline.description: Run all gates against motion spec

pipeline.title: Attest
pipeline.description: Produce signed motion artifact for downstream component compilers

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: motion-spec.json exists with animations array and easings

gates.title: Duration Range
gates.description: All durations are between 100ms and 500ms for UI feedback animations

gates.title: Reduced Motion Required
gates.description: Every animation entry has a reducedMotion override (static or opacity-only)

gates.title: Easing Valid
gates.description: All easing values are valid cubic-bezier() or named CSS keywords

gates.title: Enter/Exit Defined
gates.description: Both enter and exit transition types are defined in the spec

gates.title: No TODOs
gates.description: No TODO/FIXME/HACK in motion spec files

contracts.description: Structural requirements for a valid UI motion spec

error_codes.UMO004: Invalid easing value (not cubic-bezier or CSS keyword)
error_codes.UMO005: Enter or exit transition type not defined
error_codes.UMO006: TODO/FIXME/HACK found in motion spec files
